about: Radio Jolene's spoken lines (SND-VOICE G1626-G1629, SND-RADIO-2 G1682). tools/audio/prep_voice.js renders: src/viewer/audio/radio_talk.js's clipLines(places) - the station's own lines exactly as its talk says them (LINES, the greetings, the time check, the pilots' and the marine forecast's phrases, one line per place below) -, src/viewer/audio/voice_model.js's VOCAB (the AWOS and marine words), one back-announce per track of src/viewer/audio/music_catalogue.json, and any extra 'lines' here, into media/audio/voice/. 'say' respells a word for the voice only. 'places': Jolene's one-way strips [name, look] and sea lanes (world.aerodromes, read off the shipped world) - a place the game has and this list lacks is read by speechSynthesis.
